hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 55 min System Design Reliability

Reliability at Scale: SLOs, Multi-Region & DR

After this page you can turn "it must be highly available" into numbers (nines, SLOs, error budgets, RPO, RTO), pick the right failover and disaster-recovery setup, contain failures with cells, prove it with observability and chaos tests, and say all of it calmly in an interview.
